format: Nested JSON with context and lookups
help: Use * for each array level, for example /visits/*/acquisitions. Row fields are relative to an acquisition. Context fields use a full document path, such as /visits/*/id or /configuration/frequency. Wildcards refer to the same parent indices as the acquisition. Lookup fields are relative to the matching control or configuration row. Numbers retain exact spelling; lookup keys match both spelling and JSON value type. Unmatched rows remain visible when you choose to keep them.
packed: Extract fixed-width records from this array
packedFields: Map /0 to the first value in each record, /1 to the second, and so on.
packedSummary: {name} at {path}: {count} records per window, {width} array elements per record, starting at offset {offset} (zero-based).
packedHelp: Skip the declared offset, then read exactly the declared number of records at the chosen width. For six values per record, map fields /0 through /5. Each value keeps its original array position. The extracted count must equal the acquisition count in each window. A short source fails; elements before or after the selected range remain in the original evidence and are not included in this dataset.
positionMode: Same array position within each window
positionHelp: The first acquisition uses the first lookup entry, the second uses the second, and so on, separately within each parent window. Both arrays must exist and have exactly the same length, including empty windows. Every selected value keeps its exact source location. Add separate positional lookups for controls, configuration and schedules when each has one entry per acquisition.
unmatched: When a key has no match
reject: Stop and report the missing match
keep: Keep the acquisition with absent lookup values
